text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—Keep your head completely empty while 
running.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't think of anything else anymore. 
All I knew was—I was running.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I just ran and ran like crazy. Because I 
ran—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Bad things happened before, like with my 
hooves. But I feel like I got just as much 
good luck to make up for it.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan takes 1st!! Against all the 
odds, it's Tosen Jordan!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Haa... *gasp*... I... I'm gonna...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Trai... ner...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...A splendid result. Did you carefully 
calculate the timing of your move 
specifically for today?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Forgive me. You don't have to force 
yourself to speak. It was an exhausting, 
all-out race, after all."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I was surprised watching Jordan-san's 
lead too. I had no idea such positioning 
was even possible."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It's as if you could already see the path 
forward. Could it be that you foresaw the 
pack's formation starting from the third 
corner?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: H-Huh...? What...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I thought so too! To think you 
anticipated how the race would unfold that 
far ahead...!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(What are these people... even talking 
about?)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It really made me think about how to make 
the most of the final stretch. *sigh*... 
Guess we'll have a review meeting once we 
get back.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I need to push myself forward more 
aggressively too. ...I really learned that 
you can't seize what's right there 
otherwise.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(What are you... talking about? 
...Seriously, what is this about...?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Still, let me congratulate you first. 
After all, you're the one who claimed the 
title of the strongest in this race for 
supremacy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... I will not make the same mistake 
twice. Next time, I shall come thoroughly 
prepared.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...I won't lose next time either. Next 
time, without fail—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...I will win against you.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: —Kh!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...What was that...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Are you all aliens or something?

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Jordan-san! That was a magnificent race!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah..., ...Haah.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that was an absolutely masterful 
race! Was that your plan all along?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …………Ah. Huh.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Not really. I wasn't thinking about 
anything."

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
I see, so you're not showing your hand 
just yet. The others are going to have to 
devise some serious counter-strategies, 
aren't they~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...I won't lose next time either. Next 
time, without fail—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...I will win against you.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...It didn't happen today, but... I 
wonder if they'll start marking me next 
time?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Ha. Aha, so you're saying I was legit 
just lucky, then."

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Jordan-san is now one of the top 
contenders! I'm really looking forward to 
her future races!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Next spring's GⅠ season, they're 
undeniably the top favorite! I can't wait 
to see a future where they sweep them 
all!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh... Ah...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(...Wait a sec. Today was just dumb 
luck... Next time? How am I supposed 
to...)

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
Of cooourse! Jordan's amazing, after all! 
She might even win every single GⅠ race, 
right?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (...This is bad.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(If I lose next time, it'll look insanely 
uncool.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
“—Until this day arrived, there was a 
video I watched over and over again.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I knew it was gonna be tough. But then I 
heard Helios's voice, and I just went all 
out on a runaway lead to the very end!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"A-And another thing! I think getting the 
slow pace I was hoping for was also a big 
reason for my win!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...At the last Arima Kinen, Palmer was 
saying some pretty incredible stuff."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
For a second, I wondered if I'd be able to 
say something like that too once the Arima 
was over.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: —I didn't understand at all.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It's as if you could already see the path 
forward. Could it be that you foresaw the 
pack's formation starting from the third 
corner?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (...I don't get it.)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I thought so too! To think you 
anticipated how the race would unfold that 
far ahead...!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (...I don't get it, I just don't get it.)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It really made me think about how to make 
the most of the final stretch. *sigh*... 
Guess we'll have a review meeting once we 
get back.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I need to push myself forward more 
aggressively too. ...I really learned that 
you can't seize what's right there 
otherwise.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(...I don't know, I don't know, I don't 
know, I don't know, I don't know...!)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...I mean, there's no way I'd get it. I'm 
stupid, after all."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...There's no way I could pull something 
like that off.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. My bad. What were we talking about 
again?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Ah. That one, huh.

Tosen Jordan achieved splendid results in 
the Arima Kinen. Considering her 
longstanding goal of "making it big"—
choice_data_list: Why don't we aim for the Osaka Hai next?
Why don't we aim for the Osaka Hai next?

text_block_list.text:
The first race of the Spring Senior Triple 
Crown. At 2,000 meters, it's Tosen 
Jordan's specialty distance.

Even so, knowing how she's studied and 
voiced her own goals up until now... if 
she has another goal in mind, prioritizing 
that might be...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "...No, that's, like... Ah~..."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Do I really gotta pick a goal? Right now, 
it's just, like, you know...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Isn't that pretty good? Like, I'm 
totally fine with this, you know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Bye-bye! Good night, farewell! Um, 
ah... Ex-excuse? Me!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...If I go to training, will the 'next 
step' finally begin?"

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Jordan! About the after-party! Instead of 
a restaurant, wanna go hang out somewhere 
else?

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"My mom said she'd drive us! Told me I 
should relax on my days off."

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"...Jordan? You really feelin' super 
drained today? Should we just talk 
tomorrow?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah. No. Umm. That sounds... kind of 
nice."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Agreed. Well then, good night☆

After the Arima Kinen, before the New 
Year's holidays began. Just to be safe, I 
had put together training geared towards 
the Osaka Hai and other G1 races, but...
—Tosen Jordan didn't show up.
